text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan's concentration sharpened to its 
absolute peak; her entire body became 
eyes, ears, and heart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I can see horse girls without 
looking at them, and understand their 
hearts without speaking to them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can sense the Umamusume around me just 
from the air... I have reached that realm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll take in the Umamusume-chan with my 
entire being, and turn it into the 
ultimate performance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I don't quite get it, but Agnes Digital 
is getting into a great state of hype 
before the race."
